entities.name: Kristapor Ivanyan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kristapor Ivani Ivanyan was a Soviet and Armenian lieutenant general. He fought in both World War II and the First Nagorno-Karabakh War. He was one of the founders of the Nagorno-Karabakh Defense Army.
